doc: Hush key poses. Channels per TECH 4.7 (rot deg clockwise +, limbs hang down at 0, negative swings forward). `base` inherits, `mirror_of` swaps _l/_r. `props` (art-hush extension) places a prop on a socket with a state for previews; clips set the same with prop events. `residues` = overlays shown. Every grounded pose has its lowest sole point on y = 0. IK/aim/pin were solved at build time.
